mapper.sql: SELECT i.*,u.display_name invited_by_name,CASE WHEN i.status='PENDING' AND i.expires_at<=#{now} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE i.status END derived_status FROM farm_invitation i JOIN users u ON u.id=i.invited_by

SELECT a.*,a.created_at assigned_at,f.name farm_name,m.display_name manager_name,m.email manager_email,ab.display_name assigned_by_name,rb.display_name revoked_by_name, CASE WHEN a.status='ACTIVE' AND (a.starts_at>#{now} OR (a.ends_at IS NOT NULL AND a.ends_at<=#{now})) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE a.status END derived_status, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pest_control_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM harvest_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL)) recent_input_count, NULLIF(GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM work_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL),TIMESTAMP('1000-01-01 00:00:00')), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM pest_control_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL),TIMESTAMP('1000-01-01 00:00:00')), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM harvest_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL),TIMESTAMP('1000-01-01 00:00:00')), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM sales_log l WHERE l.farm_id=a.farm_id AND l.care_assignment_id=a.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL),TIMESTAMP('1000-01-01 00:00:00')) ),TIMESTAMP('1000-01-01 00:00:00')) last_input_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_quality_issue q WHERE q.farm_id=a.farm_id AND q.assigned_manager_user_id=a.manager_user_id AND q.issue_status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS')) open_issue_count FROM farm_care_assignment a JOIN farm f ON f.id=a.farm_id JOIN users m ON m.id=a.manager_user_id JOIN users ab ON ab.id=a.assigned_by LEFT JOIN users rb ON rb.id=a.revoked_by
